_meta.source: eBay UK search results (ebay.co.uk/sch/i.html, _ipg=240, Best Match) fetched 28 Sep 2026 by curl: 435 search terms, 1,200 result pages (all categories + Decorative Posters & Prints 41511 for every term, + Art Prints 360 for 330 terms) and 55 seller pages (_ssn=<seller>). 'sold' = eBay's lifetime 'X sold' counter on multi-quantity active listings (not a time window; '+' values are floors). Sold/completed search needs sign-in and was not used. result_count = eBay 'N+ results' for result_count_term across all categories. Evidence counts are for image listings only (personalised/word-art listings excluded). Rows are matched by regex over listing titles; see raw/image/method/rows.py.
